recs.title: Recommendations
recs.subtitle: What is worth doing now, most important first. Recalculated from your store data every time you open this page.
recs.load_error: We could not load the recommendations.
recs.no_store_title: Connect your store to get recommendations
recs.no_store_desc: Recommendations start from your store's catalog, stock and sales.
recs.impact: At stake: {{revenue}} in the last 90 days
recs.no_recent_sales: No website sales in the last 90 days: stock and margin recommendations need sales.
recs.all_good_desc: Your store is ready. Check back after your next sales.
recs.footer: Recommendations are calculated from your synced catalog, website orders from the last 90 days and the settings of your store and Google account.
recs.store_revoked_title: Access to the {{platform}} store was stopped
recs.store_revoked_body: Hontrio no longer receives new products and orders, so campaigns would run on stale data. Reconnect your store in Settings.
recs.google_not_connected_body: Without it, Hontrio cannot create and run campaigns. Campaigns run in your own account and you pay Google directly.
recs.ads_account_missing_title: Choose the Google Ads account to use
recs.ads_account_missing_body: Your Google account is connected, but no Google Ads account is selected for the campaigns.
recs.merchant_missing_title: Link your store to Google Merchant Center
recs.merchant_missing_body: Product ads (Shopping and Performance Max) are built from your Merchant Center catalog. Without it, your products cannot appear in ads.
recs.conversion_missing_body: Without it, Google Ads cannot tell which clicks turned into orders and cannot optimize campaigns for sales.
recs.google_issues_title: Products disapproved or with errors at Google: {{count}}
recs.google_issues_body: These offers cannot appear in ads until the issue Google flagged is fixed. The Merchant page in Edinio shows the reason for each one. They are sorted by sales.
recs.price_unconfirmed_body: The catalog price is not what customers pay (personalization changes the total), so Edinio does not send them to Google: a price that differs between the ad and the page gets offers suspended. They are sent again once the catalog price becomes the starting price.
recs.not_sent_title: Offers not sent to Merchant Center: {{count}}
recs.not_sent_body: Merchant Center is linked, but these offers never got there. This usually resolves with the next Edinio sync; if not, check the Merchant Center page in Edinio.
recs.out_of_stock_title: Products that sell but are sold out: {{count}}
recs.out_of_stock_body: They had sales in the last 90 days. While they are sold out they cannot be promoted, so their sales are lost.
recs.low_stock_body: At the sales pace of the last 90 days, their stock lasts less than {{days}} days.
recs.missing_costs_title: Selling products without a cost price: {{count}}
recs.missing_costs_body: Without the product cost, Hontrio cannot know how much it can spend on ads while a sale stays profitable. They are sorted by revenue.
recs.negative_margin_body: The cost entered is higher than the selling price, so every sale loses money. Check the cost price or the store price; until then, the campaign plan leaves them out.
recs.thin_margin_body: Their margin is under {{pct}}%, so ads would need a very high ROAS to be profitable. The campaign plan leaves them out; you can include them.
recs.break_even_body: At the {{margin}}% average margin of the products you sell, ads pay for themselves from a ROAS of {{roas}}. Below that, campaigns lose money.
recs.break_even_vat: The threshold includes VAT ({{vat}}%): Google Ads reports the order value with VAT, but you keep the amount without VAT.
recs.break_even_discount: It also accounts for the discounts you give, {{discount}}% of product value.
recs.discounts_over_margin_body: The average margin of the products you sell is {{margin}}%, while discounts reach {{discount}}% of sales: before any ad, sales no longer make a profit. Check your cost prices and discounts.
recs.missing_gtin_title: Offers without a GTIN or MPN: {{count}}
recs.missing_gtin_body: If they are products from other manufacturers, they have a barcode (GTIN): once added in {{platform}}, Google shows them more often. Own-brand products don't need one.
recs.merchant_fix_edinio: You link it from Edinio, under Google Merchant Center.
recs.merchant_fix_woocommerce: In WooCommerce, the easiest way is the free Google for WooCommerce plugin: it sends your products and keeps the feed up to date.
recs.conversion_fix_edinio: You set it up from Edinio, under Google Ads.
recs.conversion_fix_woocommerce: In WooCommerce, Google for WooCommerce sets it up when you link your Google Ads account; a plugin like Pixel Manager works too.
recs.break_even_vat_assumed: The threshold assumes {{vat}}% VAT, the country's standard rate, because orders show no VAT: Google Ads reports the order value with VAT, but you keep the amount without it.
recs.merchant_fix_shopify: In Shopify, the easiest way is the free Google & YouTube app: it sends your products to Merchant Center and keeps the feed up to date.
recs.conversion_fix_shopify: In Shopify, the Google & YouTube app sets it up when you link your Google Ads account.

campaigns.type_pmax_hint: One campaign for the whole eligible catalog: Google shows your products in Search, Shopping, YouTube, Gmail and Discover and learns where they sell. With few sales, one campaign learns faster than several small ones.
campaigns.bidding_target: Maximize conversion value, with a target ROAS of {{roas}}

campaigns.econ_need_costs: To work out the profit threshold and the target ROAS, add the cost price to the products that sell. Right now {{pct}}% of sales have a cost; at least half is needed.
campaigns.econ_margin_sales: of the campaign products, from 90 days of sales
campaigns.econ_margin_catalog: of the campaign products, from cost prices
campaigns.econ_break_even_sub: below it, the campaign loses money
campaigns.econ_aov_sub: what Google Ads reports for a sale
campaigns.adjust_intro: The threshold accounts for what Google Ads receives: the order total.
campaigns.adjust_vat: Of that, the {{vat}}% VAT does not stay with you.
campaigns.forecast_title: Per month, if the campaign hits the target
campaigns.forecast_note: Estimate. Sales include VAT, as Google reports them; profit is without VAT and before fixed costs. The first weeks are for learning, and after launch the real figures appear in Reports.
campaigns.empty_included: No product enters the campaign right now.
campaigns.col_break_even_hint: The ROAS from which a sale of the product pays for its ad
campaigns.no_cost_hint: Add the cost price in Products to see the margin
campaigns.over_target_hint: Above the {{roas}} target ROAS: at the campaign target, its sales can lose money
campaigns.footer: The plan is worked out from your synced catalog, website orders from the last 90 days and your cost prices. Removed products stay untouched in Merchant Center: Hontrio only keeps them out of the campaign.
campaigns.blocker_merchant_woocommerce: Send your products to Merchant Center (Google for WooCommerce)

campaigns.conversion_ok: Purchase, the one already set up via {{via}} (no new one is created)
campaigns.conversion_ok_unknown: Purchase, the one already set up (no new one is created)
campaigns.verified_at_launch: Hontrio cannot ask the plugin from here: we check it at launch, from the Google account.
campaigns.adjust_vat_assumed: Your store does not calculate VAT, so the math assumes the {{vat}}% standard rate, which you do not keep.

support.title: Support
support.subject: Subject
support.faq_connect: How do I connect my WooCommerce store?
support.faq_connect_a: Go to Settings → Integrations and enter your store URL along with the Consumer Key and Consumer Secret from WooCommerce → Settings → Advanced → REST API.
support.faq_credits_a: Each AI action uses credits: SEO text generation costs 5 credits, section regeneration costs 2 credits, and image generation costs 2-4 credits depending on the style.
support.faq_sync: Why doesn't sync bring all products?
support.faq_sync_a: Check if the WooCommerce API key has Read permissions. If using Cloudflare, make sure our IPs are not blocked. You can retry the sync from the Products page.
support.faq_image: How long does AI image generation take?
support.faq_image_a: Usually 20-60 seconds per image, depending on the chosen style. "White Background" images are the fastest.
support.reply_24h: We reply within 24h on business days
support.no_tickets_status: No tickets with the selected status
support.help_desc: If you have a problem, we're here to help.
support.faq_connect_q: How do I connect my WooCommerce store?
support.faq_sync_q: Why doesn't sync bring all products?
support.faq_image_q: How long does AI image generation take?
support.faq_publish_q: How do I publish products back to WooCommerce?
support.faq_publish_a: From a product's SEO page, after saving the content, click "Publish to store". The product will be updated directly in WooCommerce.
support.faq_cms_q: Can I use Hontrio with another CMS?
support.faq_cms_a: Currently we only support WooCommerce. Shopify and other platforms are on the roadmap.
